title: Microsoft Teams: Branded Meeting Reactions
description: With new branded reactions, organizations can now extend their visual identity directly into meetings. IT admins simply upload custom reaction icons reflecting brand elements or event themes, and these instantly become available for meeting participants.  A simple way to create more cohesive, on-brand meeting experiences.
